fato_historico: 2025: The Wang Fuk Court fire, a catastrophic fire in Tai Po, Hong Kong, leaves at least 168 dead and 79 injured.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you may feel a deep call to nurture your community and offer warmth to those around you. Perhaps today is a good time to shine light where shadows have fallen, remembering that even after the darkest flickers of sorrow, the resilience of the human heart glows brighter than ever. Consider sharing your kindness freely.
frase_do_dia: Your bright spirit can turn any shadow into a beautiful new beginning.
significado_numero: Represents the strength found in rebuilding after challenging cycles.
conselho: Reach out to a friend and share a message of hope and comfort.
